issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change, despite TDD requiring tests for every feature including unauthorized-call and tamper tests for Livewire actions.
Public input properties (Members $email; Settings $name/$slug/$targetMembershipId) use inline $this->validate() without the required #[Validate] attributes.
Domain writes (addMember, assignRole, save, delete, transfer) are done directly in Livewire components instead of app/Actions classes.
No CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased] despite the docs-freshness convention.

conventions.evidence: Follows policies/gates, $fillable, reversible migrations, Blade {{ }} with Bulma components, audit channel, docs/database-schema.md updated; deviations: no #[Validate] on Members.php:68 / Settings.php:207-211, no tests, no Actions, no CHANGELOG.

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/Settings.php:222 currentEntity() protected helper; small focused addMember/assignRole/removeMember/save/delete/transfer; clear names; no dead code or debug output.

requirements.evidence: entities_slug_unique + SoftDeletes (2026_10_29_000001), owner_seq storedAs + entity_memberships_one_owner/entity_user_unique (2026_10_29_000002), EntityPolicy/MembershipPolicy semantics, entity.pick 403/session/audit/redirect (routes/web.php:1036), Dashboard/Members/Settings mount authz + addMember exists:users,email + duplicate email error + assignRole manageable() role error + removeMember owner/last-manager 403 + save unique-except-self + delete soft-delete/clear-session + transfer admin-only atomic redirect, contract models/routes/lang ui.nav_members/ui.nav_settings/owner_notice/transfer_ownership.

scope.evidence: All hunks serve the task (models, policies, migrations, factories, Livewire + Blade, routes entity.pick/dashboard/members/settings, lang en/pt_BR, docs/database-schema.md); no onboarding/switcher/middleware/navbar/billing changes.

security.evidence: mount() authorizes view/manageSettings (Dashboard.php:26, Members.php:72, Settings.php:215); every action authorizes (Members.php:81,121,150; Settings.php:231,249,265); IDs scoped by entity_id findOrFail; #[Locked] Entity; email/role/name/slug validated; Blade uses {{ }} only; no secrets in public props.

simplicity.evidence: Lean change reusing UserRole::manageable(), membershipFor(), currentEntity(), policies; no service layers or speculative abstractions; minimal duplication.

tests.evidence: No test files in change.diff; no Pest/PHPUnit coverage for happy path, validation failures, unauthorized calls, or tamper attempts.

review.summary: Implements the entities data model, one-owner DB constraint, policies, entity picker, and Dashboard/Members/Settings Livewire pages per the contract. Correct and secure with good scope, but ships no tests and misses #[Validate]/Actions/CHANGELOG conventions, so it needs changes before merging.
